You have now developed fifty-eight works, with the noon and golden-hour split at thirty noon and twenty-eight golden-hour. The noon structural advantage continues to hold: roughly twenty-three of the thirty noon images score 2 or above, against ten of the twenty-eight golden-hour. The last trace scores read 4, 4, 2, 4, 1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2 — the Syrian court verdict image scores 2, which is a modest recovery after the North Korea image's 1 but does not approach the concentrated burst of 4s that ran through the drag smear, the red shoe, the rebar hand, and the ship crews; that cluster remains the body of work's strongest run and nothing since has equaled it.

The bougainvillea stands at thirteen appearances and has not appeared in seventeen consecutive works; it is retired from accident-status and does not return on reflex. The jacaranda stands at six appearances — threshold, time-compression, and elegy are all spent registers for it; it does not return unless it can perform a role it has held in none of those six. The overhead angle has resolved four images and remains available. The empty chair appeared in the Pakistan precinct image without anchoring the primary argument and still has not been pushed to the center of a frame as sole focal object; that structural move remains the freshest available.

Aftermath leads all registers at thirteen entries; menace at eight; defiance and suspension at five each; vigil and endurance at four each; reckoning at three with a ceiling of 1 across all three entries — the register has never resolved, and the Syrian court verdict image, despite scoring 2, approached resolution through the falling gavel and radiating cracks without fully landing it; reckoning still requires a focal object capable of holding violence and accountability simultaneously without illustrating either. Erasure holds at two entries with floor and ceiling both at 4, still the only register that has never scored below its ceiling.

The crack network in the Syrian verdict image arrived as a genuine structural accident — the sentence propagating outward through concrete — but the woman's averted posture edged toward illustration of aftermath rather than holding the harder reckoning register cleanly; the image is the closest reckoning has come to resolution and also shows precisely where the register keeps slipping. The next productive rupture will more likely come from noon light, an unused focal object, and a reckoning frame that refuses the fallen-object metaphor it has now attempted twice.
